newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges curbing multi-nationals' investment.
newsitem.headline: China urges curbing multi-nationals' investment.

text.p: The State Planning Commission has urged Beijing to curb investment by multi-nationals in large Chinese firms to prevent foreigners from manipulating the domestic markets, the Business News said on Monday.

A recent report by the commission said multi-nationals were highly competitive and their entrance into China was sometimes not helpful to China's aim of using foreign investment to upgrade its technology, the newspaper said.
The commission said China must avoid letting multi-nationals acquire controlling shares in large Chinese firms and must strictly control the number of their subsidiaries in China, the newspaper said.

China must use both legal and administrative means to prevent multi-nationals from manipulating the Chinese marketplace particularly basic sectors such as automobiles, micro-electronics and petrochemicals, the commission said.
But China can encourage the foreign firms to invest more in medium and small-scale Chinese enterprises, it added.
